title: Registered hypotheses, first round: results on the hold-out creators (model-coded)

statements.model_coded: Every label behind these results was produced by language models from frozen prompts; no person has checked the labels (registry A1, A8). Every result is model-coded, and the strongest verdicts available are "supported (model-coded)" and "refuted (model-coded)". Agreement between models is reported as agreement, not accuracy (A1).
statements.registered_rule: A hypothesis is "supported (model-coded)" only if its Holm step passes (Holm-adjusted p at most 0.05, the count fixed at 10: H3 and H8 enter at p = 1, H7 and H10, not run, at p = 1; A9, A10.1), its registered support rule holds (hypotheses.md), the A5 interval excludes zero and its registered effect-size condition holds (A8). It is "refuted (model-coded)" when its registered refutation holds; refutations read from intervals are unadjusted (A10.1). Fewer eligible creators than its minimum gives "not determinable" (A10.2), an instrument below its reliability floor "not run for want of an instrument" (A10.5); otherwise the result is "not determined", with the conditions that failed.
statements.a5: A5 (registry, 2026-11-20, after H3 was tested): "supported" also requires the 90% interval over creators to exclude zero. For the amended versions of H5 and H6, both the t interval on the creator OE values and the wider Mantel-Haenszel interval must exclude it (decision of 2026-11-21 06:44 (5)).
statements.a10_guard: A10 guard (registry 2026-11-21 03:08, completed at 04:55): wherever A10 replaces a registered estimator, reference, minimum, interval or centring, the registered and the amended versions are computed on the same data. The larger of their two p values enters Holm (a version that cannot be run has p = 1). A verdict stands only if both versions give it; otherwise the result reads "not determined: the registered and the amended versions differ". If either version is not determinable, the result is "not determinable", with the reason naming the version, and it is flagged uninformative. Both versions are printed.
statements.uninformative: a result is uninformative when its 90% creator interval contains both zero and the smallest effect of interest in either direction, or its verdict is not determinable (registry 02:50)
statements.verification_wording: Supported and refuted verdicts read "verified by a third model, on known-answer texts and by a reader of another vendor", with the figures entered in the run's config (registry A10 part 2, 2026-11-21 03:08).
statements.small_cells: No figure here rests on fewer than 5 creators. Such a count is printed as "fewer than 5"; two printed counts of hold-out creators never differ by 1 to 4 (a count that would is stated against the other, as "all but fewer than 5 of N"), nor lie 1 to 4 from a count of hold-out creators published elsewhere (such a count is stated against its minimum); an estimate, its interval and a version's p are printed only where the result is determinable and the version rests on 5 or more creators with a non-zero value; a robustness row resting on fewer than 5 creators is listed without a verdict, and the flag "robust to the labeller" reads the published rows only; an agreement figure (a kappa or a share of items coded alike, on R-hold or the hold-out) is printed only where its positive code comes from 5 or more creators in each reading and the creators with an item the readings code differently are none or 5 or more (a minor code both readings give alike is not a cell of its own); counts of valid calls or quotations are given as shares, without their shortfalls. No creator, channel, recording, title or quotation appears.
statements.scope: Confirmatory estimates read the hold-out creators only (decision of 2026-11-21 04:55 (h)); H9 pairs hold-out cells with seen cells. The first round runs H1, H2, H4, H5, H6 and H9.
statements.a10_guard_as_run: the larger of the registered and the amended p enters Holm; a verdict stands only if both versions give it; if either version is not determinable, the result is not determinable (registry 2026-11-21 04:55)
statements.holm: Holm over m = 10 at family-wise 0.05; ties are ordered by the registry's hypothesis order, as the analysis orders them; p values are printed as the report rounds them (4 decimals)
